propositions: A new link relation `caused_by` must be added as a 7th directional, non-blocking, cycle-permitting relation following the `discovered_from` precedent to express bug provenance.
The relation must be defined in the schema enum, regenerated into the Relation Literal type, and added to CANONICAL_RELATIONS in _links.py.
The hardcoded non-blocking tuple at src/rebar/graph/_graph.py line ~204 must include `caused_by` or the relation will incorrectly gain blocking-cycle semantics.
The relation must be Jira-unmapped (like discovered_from, duplicates, supersedes) and omitted from the Jira reconciler outbound_links mappings.
CLI help text, golden snapshots, and documentation must be updated to enumerate the 7th relation and explain its causal semantics.

A caused_by link must round-trip through store and reduce without error, remain non-blocking in graph traversal, permit two-node cycles, and respect backward compatibility with pre-existing LINK events.
